name: LaRA
description: LaRA is a benchmark designed to rigorously compare Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG) and long-context large language models across 2326 test cases covering four QA task categories and three types of naturally occurring long texts.
reputation: A recent benchmark used in RAG and long-context evaluation papers, but not yet a widely standardized community leaderboard.
notes: Focuses on practical QA tasks and evaluates multiple open-source and proprietary LLMs.
